title: DINNER LADY 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid – Mango Tart
description:
Dinner lady Mango Tart is the mouth-watering dessert flavour. The fruity mango flavour is mixed with Dinner Lady’s famous pastry base to please any dessert flavour lovers.
On Inhale, the juicy mango flavour is present, followed with sweet pastry base on exhale for a well-balanced vape e-liquid.
Flavours:
Mango
Tart
VG/PG:
70% VG, 30% PG
Bottle size:
60ml filled with 50ml for your nicotine shot.
Nicotine Levels:
Zero – 0mg
